description: On the tabletop there’s a small white lamp-like assembly with a cylindrical shade on a base, and a red backdrop behind it. The left hand stays planted on the base to steady it as the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the cylindrical shade as a right-hand object, lifts it upward and tilts it away to remove it from the central stem, then carries it down and sets it on the table to the right, leaving the round bulb top exposed.
